rows.label: BELAY
rows.clue: Something to which a mountain climber's rope can be secured

rows.label: TRACK
rows.clue: A line or route along which something travels or moves

rows.label: CHASM
rows.clue: A deep opening in the earth's surface

rows.label: CANAL
rows.clue: (astronomy) an indistinct surface feature of Mars once thought to be a system of channels

rows.label: TIDAL BASIN
rows.clue: A basin that is full of water at high tide

rows.label: TIDEWATER
rows.clue: Low-lying coastal land drained by tidal streams

rows.label: REEF
rows.clue: A submerged ridge of rock or coral near the surface of the water

rows.label: CLIFF
rows.clue: A steep high face of rock

rows.label: TIDAL RIVER
rows.clue: A stream in which the effects of the tide extend far upstream

rows.label: GEYSER
rows.clue: A spring that discharges hot water and steam

rows.label: RETARDANT
rows.clue: Any agent that retards or delays or hinders

rows.label: WATER SYSTEM
rows.clue: A river and all of its tributaries

rows.label: SALT FLAT
rows.clue: A flat expanse of salt left by the evaporation of a body of salt water

rows.label: HYDROGEN ION
rows.clue: A positively charged atom of hydrogen

rows.label: RIFT
rows.clue: A gap between cloud masses

rows.label: SCRAPING
rows.clue: (usually plural) a fragment scraped off of something and collected

rows.label: VARIABLE
rows.clue: Something that is likely to vary

rows.label: OZONE LAYER
rows.clue: A layer in the stratosphere (at approximately 20 miles) that contains a concentration of ozone sufficient to block most ultraviolet radiation from the sun

rows.label: STRETCH
rows.clue: A large and unbroken expanse or distance

rows.label: TAR PIT
rows.clue: A natural accumulation of bitumens at the surface of the earth

rows.label: LLANO
rows.clue: An extensive grassy and nearly treeless plain (especially in Latin America)

rows.label: HANGING WALL
rows.clue: The upper wall of an inclined fault

rows.label: HIGHLAND
rows.clue: Elevated (e.g., mountainous) land

rows.label: REMAINS
rows.clue: Any object that is left unused or still extant

rows.label: INESSENTIAL
rows.clue: Anything that is not essential

rows.label: RIFT VALLEY
rows.clue: A valley with steep sides

rows.label: BARRIER REEF
rows.clue: A long coral reef near and parallel to the shore

rows.label: CORAL REEF
rows.clue: A reef consisting of coral consolidated into limestone

rows.label: LAGOON
rows.clue: A body of water cut off from a larger body by a reef of sand or coral

rows.label: SUPERNOVA
rows.clue: A star that explodes and becomes extremely luminous in the process
